name: Complex Society
source:
Complex Society  is the story about a student who moves to a new city to study.  After a few years living in a rented room in a house, he started developing feelings towards the two women there.  After some time feeling confused and conflicted by these feelings he decides to move on with his life.  He will have plenty of others girls to be entertained by and maybe an e-sports career in the best Fighting Game of all time, but one day he finds a classmate in an unusual situation and suddenly his life will take on a new perspective.

[from [url=https://www.patreon.com/abrokenaproductions]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《复杂社会》讲述了一名学生搬到新城市学习的故事。在出租屋里住了几年后，他开始对那里的两个女人产生了感情。一段时间后，他因这些感觉而感到困惑和矛盾，他决定继续自己的生活。他将有很多其他女孩可以娱乐，也许还可以在有史以来最好的格斗游戏中开启电子竞技生涯，但有一天，他发现一位同学处境不寻常，突然之间，他的生活将呈现出新的视角。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/abrokenaproductions]Patreon[/url]]
